preset.text: Nothing But Net is 1-on-1 pickup basketball. You and your opponent trade possession — one of you is on offense, the other on defense. First to the target score wins!
Before tip-off, each of you drafts special Trick cards into your deck — game-changers like Pump Fake, Alley Oop, and Ankle Breaker.
Play cards one at a time to set up your shot. Pass and Drive build the play; finish with a Shoot or Dunk. The dice decide if it drops!
You get a short window to react. Block a shot, Steal a pass, or Foul to send them to the line. Stop them and the ball is yours.
Miss a shot? A Rebound keeps possession. Score? An And1 earns a bonus throw. Fall behind and you'll get catch-up drafts. First to the target score wins!
Players will alternate drafting cards into their personal draw deck.
